spec.title: Example 142 killed mid-proof leaves its stage logs and workspace behind
spec.description: Step 3d of llm-dlc/loops/build-orchestration.md, its acceptance: an interrupted job leaves its stage logs and workspace behind. build.py runs example 142 (the own checker's ASCII fast-path proof, about 7 s of solving after a few seconds of building) and is killed by SIGKILL after 5 s, when the proof should be running. Afterwards the kept workspace under .build-py must hold the attempt's claim.json, its patched copy, and logs/stages.jsonl whose last stage is still marked running, with that stage's partial stdout file present. The step fails if build.py finished before the kill (exit other than 137) or if any of these is missing; the timing assumption is part of what is checked.
spec.expected: build.py is killed (exit 137) during a stage; the attempt's claim.json, patched copy and stages.jsonl remain, the last stage marked running with its stdout file present

steps.name: kill build.py mid-proof and inspect what it left
steps.run: timeout -s KILL 5 python3 examples/tools/build.py 142; code=$?; test $code = 137 || { echo "build.py exited $code before the kill"; exit 1; }; a=$(ls -d .build-py/examples-*/attempts/142/attempt-* | head -1); test -f $a/claim.json && test -d $a/copy/examples/apps/mica && tail -1 $a/logs/stages.jsonl | grep -q '"status": "running"' && n=$(tail -1 $a/logs/stages.jsonl | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["stdout"])') && test -f $a/$n && echo "left: $(tail -1 $a/logs/stages.jsonl)"
